svg.text: Fig 2: WSCG time series — hand couple C_alpha,M(t) vs ZTCF passive vs COM moment (N·m vs s)

Plain-language takeaway: The hand couple turns negative before impact and tracks the ZTCF branch on this simulated trajectory (|ZTCF|/|BASE| = 86.04% at t=0.2151 s; modeled ratio, not measured muscle passivity).
Frame: F_FSP (functional swing plane) | Sign convention: +CCW uncocking | Bands: propagated grip-force residual (sigma_force ~ 16.7 N per axis)
Legend: Blue = Total hand couple C_alpha,M | Green dashed = ZTCF passive | Orange = COM moment M_alpha,G
